title: Trustee intake of a version-3 ballot record: admission over the questions with its membership proof, the share hash, decryption and the share receipt
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v3-records-vectors.py, as for ballot-v3-records.json, with Intake and receipts implemented over version 3's admission, reusing share-encryption-vectors.py (KEM keys, encryption, decryption) and share-receipt-vectors.py (the receipt and its RFC 6979 P-256 signature); membership proofs and pairing verdicts from snarkjs as for ballot-v3-records.json. The delivery-malformed cases are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules
